liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Hard To Handle** (4 reviews, 1 other source): Reviewer says this performance smokes; Pigpen's performance has raw, primal energy [2][4][7][11][12]
- **Good Lovin'** (3 reviews): Singled out as an exceptional version; Stood out to the reviewer even while tripping; others at the show agreed [11][12][14]
- **Truckin'** (1 other source): Tape fades in partway through, at the words about a typical daydream [2]
- **It Hurts Me Too** (1 review): Pigpen sings with full force and Garcia's guitar is sharp [4]

## The recordings

- **gd71-03-14.sbd.cole.6115.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 14 songs; 114 min; rated 4.58/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: Described as a very crisp soundboard recording; Sounds good for 1971, with Garcia's vocals notably clear; Cymbals during Hard To Handle sound harsh; the rest of the recording is acceptable [4][5][6][7][8]
- **gd1971-03-14.sbd.lai.6249.shnf**: soundboard; 14 songs; 115 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1971-03-14.sbd.130581.MrBill.flac16**: soundboard; 14 songs; 107 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [3]

## Around the show

- New Riders of the Purple Sage opened the show [3]
- Good Lovin' probably peaked in April; this show seems overlooked next to neighboring concerts [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd71-03-14.sbd.cole.6115.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Jim Oade and Brian Cole; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Provided by Jim Oade from his collection and seeded to etree; Minor editing follows Good Lovin'; moderate editing occurs during Hard To Handle [1]
- **gd1971-03-14.sbd.lai.6249.shnf**: transferred by Mike Lai; source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Source came via Paul B. and was seeded to etree by Mike Lai [2]
- **gd1971-03-14.sbd.130581.MrBill.flac16**: transferred by Bill Guarneri; source: Recording Info: SBD > MR > DAT > CD; Transfer Info: CD > WAV > Sound Forge 10 > TLH > FLAC [3]
